mapper.select: SELECT id, command_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, auction_window_id, campaign_id, bidder_user_id, post_id, resource_type, bid_amount, reserve_price, window_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM promotion_auction_command WHERE command_id = #{commandId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, command_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, auction_window_id, campaign_id, bidder_user_id, post_id, resource_type, bid_amount, reserve_price, window_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ( (SELECT id, command_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, auction_window_id, campaign_id, bidder_user_id, post_id, resource_type, bid_amount, reserve_price, window_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM promotion_auction_command WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id, command_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, auction_window_id, campaign_id, bidder_user_id, post_id, resource_type, bid_amount, reserve_price, window_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM promotion_auction_command WHERE status = 'PUBLISHING' AND updated_at <= #{publishStaleBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id, command_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, auction_window_id, campaign_id, bidder_user_id, post_id, resource_type, bid_amount, reserve_price, window_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM promotion_auction_command WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND updated_at <= #{decisionStaleBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}) ) publishable ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
